accepts_hit.type:
∀ {tree : Rule30Submission.Certificate} {m c : ℕ},
  Rule30Submission.accepts tree m c = true →
    ∀ {R : ℕ → Bool},
      Rule30Submission.HasPrefix m c R →
        ∃ j k,
          Rule30Submission.Certificate.hasHit j k tree ∧
            j ≤ tree.deadline ∧
              Rule30Submission.Rule30SidewaysLocks.winW 30 R (1 + 2 * j) ∈
                Rule30Submission.Rule30SidewaysLocks.cls 30 Rule30Submission.Rule30SidewaysLocks.lock7Codes ↑k

deadline_iff.type:
∀ (m c j : ℕ),
  (∀ (R : ℕ → Bool), Rule30Submission.HasPrefix m c R → Rule30Submission.Locked R j) ↔
    ∃ tree, Rule30Submission.accepts tree m c = true ∧ tree.deadline ≤ j

eventual_iff.type:
∀ (m c : ℕ),
  (∀ (R : ℕ → Bool), Rule30Submission.HasPrefix m c R → ∃ j, Rule30Submission.Locked R j) ↔
    ∃ tree, Rule30Submission.accepts tree m c = true

centre_bound_of_certificate.type:
∀ {tree : Rule30Submission.Certificate} {m c A : ℕ},
  Rule30Submission.accepts tree m c = true →
    Rule30Submission.HasPrefix m c (Rule30Submission.rightAt A) →
      ∃ h,
        A + h ≤ 2 * (A + 1 + 2 * tree.deadline) ∧
          Ruliology.CellularAutomata.Rule30Jen.cell (A + h) 0 ≠
            Ruliology.CellularAutomata.Rule30PeriodTwoCoupled.altCol h

no_period_two_of_cofinal_certificates.type:
(∀ (B : ℕ),
    ∃ A ≥ B,
      Ruliology.CellularAutomata.Rule30Jen.cell A 0 = true ∧
        ∃ m c tree,
          Rule30Submission.accepts tree m c = true ∧ Rule30Submission.HasPrefix m c (Rule30Submission.rightAt A)) →
  ¬∃ T,
      ∀ (t : ℕ),
        T ≤ t → Ruliology.CellularAutomata.Rule30Jen.cell (t + 2) 0 = Ruliology.CellularAutomata.Rule30Jen.cell t 0
